name: GearBeacon
releaseNotes: GearBeacon 1.4.2 development changes since 1.4.1: fixed Watchlist auto-buy action placement; independent restock-date confirmation and alerts; exact restock insights; polling-aware health; safe product restore validation and IPv6 support-bundle redaction; bounded SMTP connection and TLS setup with accepted-message deduplication; native service permissions, build identity and Windows exit reporting; updated development and security tooling. Schema v15 and export format v10 are unchanged. See the curated release notes for upgrade guidance.
